name: Diepsloot

queries.query: Diepsloot cadastral parcels official map GIS South Africa; Diepsloot cadastre erf parcels official Johannesburg GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the national Chief Surveyor-General spatial cadastral program, a public South Africa cadastre ArcGIS service, and the City of Johannesburg Corporate Geo-Informatics property/cadastral viewer and data-request procedures. The Johannesburg material identifies Diepsloot 388-JR erf/portion records in official land-use notices. The public service metadata was obtainable, but the bounded Planning_Cadastre point query timed out and the CSG exact-point query returned an empty feature set; no geometry sample is retained.

registryCustodians.name: Chief Surveyor-General / Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
registryCustodians.scope: National surveyed-parcel and cadastral spatial custodian; official data page describes a computerized map of South African land parcels and administrative boundaries.

registryCustodians.name: City of Johannesburg Corporate Geo-Informatics
registryCustodians.scope: Local municipal property/cadastral map and stand-information publisher for Johannesburg, including public online maps and cadastral-data request procedures.

service.name: South Africa Planning Cadastre ArcGIS MapServer
service.viewerConfiguration: Current ArcGIS REST metadata was fetched anonymously. Layer 0 is a polygon Cadastre feature layer with WGS84 (EPSG:4326), GeoJSON support, maxRecordCount 2000, and safe public fields including UniqueID, PropSrc, SG_CODE, PARCEL_NO, and PORTION.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Layer schema and CRS metadata returned. No unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Anonymous exact-point query at the unchanged WUP point requested only UniqueID, PropSrc, SG_CODE, PARCEL_NO, PORTION and no geometry was returned. Timeout is not evidence of parcel absence.
National CSG service metadata returned. Erven layer 2 is a polygon layer in EPSG:4148; public safe schema includes OBJECTID, GID, PRCL_KEY, PRCL_TYPE, PROVINCE, MAJ_REGION, PARCEL_NO and PORTION.
Anonymous exact-point query at [-25.9317614563184, 28.0108704187243] returned features: []. This exact-point miss is not evidence of citywide absence; no extent query or geometry sample was retained.
Official City of Johannesburg mobile viewer URL identified; no login, credential, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe property/ownership request was attempted.
